{{Infobox auto}}

'''Naan''' is [[dough]] fired in a [[Mud Kiln|mud kiln]]. It heals {{Value|Naan|heals}} and has no other effect.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/kiln/naan.json}}</ref> It is a renamed piece of [[bread]], so it can be used in any recipe that calls for bread.

== Obtaining ==

=== Kilning ===
{{Recipes}}
Dough becomes naan in a mud kiln in {{Value|Naan|cook_time}}. Picking up dough unlocks the recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating naan takes {{Value|Naan|eat_time}} and heals {{Value|Naan|heals}}. Unlike bread it doesn't remove harmful effects.

=== Crafting ingredient ===
Naan works as bread in [[bruschetta]], [[French Toast|French toast]], [[Honied French Toast|honied French toast]], [[Sweet Berry Toast|sweet berry toast]], [[latke]]s and [[Ice Cream|ice cream]].
{{Uses}}
